_comment: 임야(=forest) positive 후보 풀. A1~A4 프롬프트 선택 파이프라인(AP 순위 → greedy 전진선택 → LOO)의 입력. 지금까지 만든 30개 세트에서 중복·부정문·저의미 문구를 걷어내고, 설계 축(일반/겨울방어/한국임상/합법지형/치수림/텍스처)을 고루 덮도록 18개로 압축. 각 항목의 cat=설계 축, why=근거.

candidates.text: a dense green forest covering a mountain slope
a hill completely covered with trees
leafless brown deciduous forest on a slope in winter
a rough textured canopy of individual bare tree crowns following the terrain
candidates.why: 겨울림 ↔ 매끈한 벌채나지 대비: 질감 있음 + 지형 따라감

candidates.text: a mix of evergreen pine and bare brown winter oak trees
a steep mountain slope of mixed evergreen pine and oak forest
candidates.why: 소나무+참나무 혼효림, 급경사 = 국내 임상 특성

candidates.text: dark evergreen conifer forest along a mountain ridge
a conifer plantation with trees planted in regular rows on a mountainside
a wooded mountain slope with a narrow forest road or firebreak through it
natural woodland with irregular tree spacing and no straight cleared edges
candidates.why: 직선 인공 경계 없음 = 형질변경 아님 신호

candidates.text: a thin young forest of scattered small trees over rough grass and shrubs on a slope
candidates.why: 치수림·성긴림도 임야. 초지 혼동을 positive쪽에서 흡수

candidates.text: rugged tree-covered ground with no clearing or track
a rough irregular canopy texture of pine needles and bare oak branches
candidates.why: interior 인코더용: 장면 아닌 수관 질감

candidates.text: dense dark green evergreen conifer foliage
a bumpy brown canopy of many small bare tree crowns
mixed evergreen and leafless tree crowns with no smooth open gaps
candidates.why: interior용: 매끈한 빈 구간 없음 = 나지 아님

candidates.text: a tree canopy on a slope
